Under the authorized plan, Baozun may repurchase its outstanding American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing three Class A ordinary shares and/or its Class A ordinary shares.
Baozun plans to fund the buyback program using its existing cash reserves, excluding proceeds from its past global offering alongside other legally available funds.

The execution of the program remains governed by the general repurchase mandate approved by shareholders at the company’s Annual General Meeting on June 16, 2026, as well as any subsequent mandate renewals.
The authorization does not obligate Baozun to acquire a specific volume of shares and may be adjusted, suspended, or terminated at the board's discretion.
Shares of BZUN rose 1.67% to $3.05 in premarket trading on Thursday.
